title: Audits with data analysis
description: For ISA CTEEP, a Brazilian power transmission company: from manually reviewing Excel spreadsheets to an interactive system with advanced filters, visual prioritization and automatically generated PDF/Excel reports.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.intro: In the power sector, the audit review was done by hand over Excel spreadsheets: thousands of records, filters living in the analyst's head and reports built one by one. Slow, error-prone and without objective prioritization.
items: Manual review of thousands of records in Excel spreadsheets
Filters and criteria living in the analyst's head
PDF/Excel reports assembled one by one, manually
No way to prioritize which cases require attention first

phases.title: 1. Discovery of the manual process
phases.description: Understood the real audit flow: what the analyst reviewed, with which criteria and what outputs were generated.
items: Mapped review criteria and business rules of the area
Inventory of the report types that were delivered
Identified the bottlenecks of the manual process

phases.title: 2. Full-stack application
phases.description: Built an interactive system that replaced the spreadsheet: data loading, advanced filters and visualization.
items: Angular 17-18 frontend with advanced filters and interactive tables
.NET Core backend with server-side processing of datasets
Entity Framework on SQL Server for persistence

phases.title: 3. Visual prioritization
phases.description: Designed a prioritization system based on business rules, so the analyst attacks critical cases first.
items: Complex business rules translated into automatic scoring
Visual prioritization of cases by risk level
The analyst goes from searching to deciding

phases.title: 4. Automated reports
phases.description: Automated the generation of PDF and Excel reports with server-side processing for massive datasets.
items: PDF/Excel reports generated by the server
Optimization for datasets of thousands of records
Result: +60% operational efficiency measured on the real cycle

subsections.title: Interactive system instead of a spreadsheet
subsections.description: Thousands of records stop being a static spreadsheet and become a system with filters, search and views.
items: Data loading with validation and normalization
Advanced combinable filters across multiple criteria
Interactive tables with per-record detail

subsections.title: Prioritization by business rules
subsections.description: The rules that lived in the analyst's head become automatic scoring.
items: Complex business rules encoded as scoring
Visual prioritization by risk level
The analyst decides on an already-ranked list

subsections.title: Reports generated server-side
subsections.description: Reports generate themselves, optimized for massive datasets.
items: Automated PDF and Excel generation
Server-side processing so the browser doesn't hang
+60% operational efficiency in the audit cycle

items.label: Discover before automating:
items.text: without mapping the analyst's real criteria, any system automates the wrong process.

items.label: Server-side matters:
items.text: processing massive datasets on the server is what made reports viable without degrading the experience.

items.label: Prioritizing changes the work:
items.text: going from 'searching' to 'deciding' was the real efficiency leap, not the filter itself.
